trace.query: What are the criteria for the Athlete of the Year Award?

retrieved_chunks.text:
SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_548
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 3. Non-academic Awards
Initiative and Responsibility Performance, twenty percent (20%). This is defined as the positive effect observed on students aiming towards students’ welfare and development.

1.3. Selection and Screening Committee. The Committee on Awards and Recognition (comprised of Committee Chair, Co-chair and three [3] members) and the SSC Adviser will be the committee in selecting for this award if in case the award will not be given to the President of SSC.

1.4. Screening and Selection Process. The Screening and Selection Committee shall ask the top three (3) officers for a narrative report duly authenticated and signed by the adviser of the said organization and conduct a panel interview to screen and select the recipient of this award with the observance of its objective and productive evaluation as indicated earlier. A decision shall be finalized by the Committee on Awards and Recognition and SSC Adviser to whom this award is to be given.

Sec. 2. Athlete of the Year Award

1.1. Description. This award is given to a student who excels in the field of Sports.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_549
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 3. Non-academic Awards
and SSC Adviser to whom this award is to be given.

Sec. 2. Athlete of the Year Award

1.1. Description. This award is given to a student who excels in the field of Sports. His/her representation in the field of Sports made him known to other institutions through his/her exemplary performance that led to the university’s recognition, thus strengthening its external relations with other states, universities and colleges.

1.2. Recommendation

1.2.1. The Chairperson of Sports Development of this University shall recommend top three (3) performing athletes of the year. The following conditions shall be considered by the Chairperson of Sports Development prior to deliberation:

1.2.1.1. The awardee has no derogatory records reported to the Office of Students Affairs and Guidance and Counseling Office.

1.2.1.2. The awardee represented the university in the field of sports and won in various competitions recognizing the name of the university.

1.2.2.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_552
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 3. Non-academic Awards
reserve its rights to determine to whom the awards is to be given based on the objective of tis performance and conduct of panel interview.

1.4. Screening and Selection Process. The Committee on Awards and Recognition (comprises of the Committee Chair, Co-chair and three [3] members) and the Chairperson of Sports Development shall be the committee in selecting this award.

Sec. 3. Student Journalist of the Year Award and Service Awardee

3.1. Description. This award is given to students who excel in the field of campus journalism. The student journalists’ active participation in the campus publication and/or representation in press conferences and contests led to the university’s recognition and promotion.

3.2. Recommendation

3.2.1. The adviser/s of the student publication shall recommend performing student journalists for the year. The following conditions shall be considered by the adviser/s prior to deliberation:

3.2.1.1. The awardee has no derogatory records reported to the Students Affairs and Services Office and Guidance and Counseling Office.

3.2.1.2. The awardee may be a recipient of any of the two awards, depending on the following qualifications:

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_553
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 3. Non-academic Awards
Affairs and Services Office and Guidance and Counseling Office.

3.2.1.2. The awardee may be a recipient of any of the two awards, depending on the following qualifications:

Major Qualifications active participation Award exemplary represenin the production tation in competiof the campus pations pers Service Awardee Yes No Student Journalist Yes Yes of the Year

3.2.2. With a letter of recommendation, the student journalist shall attach certifications to prove authenticity of the performance.

3.2.3. In the absence of certificates, the nominee shall present a portfolio showing one’s contributions in the annuals and/ or list down all the competitions participated in, duly signed and authenticated by the publication adviser/s.

3.3. Criteria for Evaluation. The nominee of this award shall be evaluated according to the following:

3.3.1. Service Awardee

3.3.1.1. The student journalist actively participates in the production of publications: Newsletter, Magazine, Tabloid, Broadsheet and Literary Folio. This also includes covering of events, editing of articles/ pages and other publication-related tasks.

3.3.1.2.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_559
SECTION: Chapter 6 CODE OF CONDUCT FOR LSPU STUDENTS (Definition and Type of Offenses) | Article 4. Minor Awards
of the awardee, duly signed by the members of the said committee and be submitted to the Committee of Awards and Recognition noted and accepted by the Committee Chair.

Sec. 2. Service Award

2.1. Description. This award is given to students who excel in the arena of public service and rendered dedicated services to their respective department/college/office. The services provided to the department/college/office made them be known as role models in giving significance and value on the importance of commitment and work values contributory to organization’s success. The student must have served the organization/college/office for a minimum of two (2) semesters or one (1) year.

2.2. Criteria for Evaluation

2.2.1. Length of Service, sixty percent (60%). This refers to the number of semesters the students served in any organization, college or office.

2.2.2. Work Attitude, forty percent (40%). This refers to the exemplary behavior of the student within the organization, college or office.

2.2.3. It is recommended that the president of each society for each college to receive the Service Awards since he/she is elected and manages the leadership within the organization.

trace.answer_for_eval:
The criteria for the Athlete of the Year Award are:

1. The student excels in the field of Sports.
2. The student’s representation in sports has made him/her known to other institutions through exemplary performance.
3. The student’s performance has led to the university’s recognition and strengthened its external relations with other states, universities, and colleges.
4. The student has no derogatory records with OSAS or the Guidance and Counseling Office.
5. The student has represented the university and won in various competitions recognizing the university’s name.
6. The evaluation is based 70% on technical/competition-based points and 30% on student-achievement impact.

answer:
The criteria for the Athlete of the Year Award are:

1. The student excels in the field of Sports.
2. The student’s representation in sports has made him/her known to other institutions through exemplary performance.
3. The student’s performance has led to the university’s recognition and strengthened its external relations with other states, universities, and colleges.
4. The student has no derogatory records with OSAS or the Guidance and Counseling Office.
5. The student has represented the university and won in various competitions recognizing the university’s name.
6. The evaluation is based 70% on technical/competition-based points and 30% on student-achievement impact.
